Description: adurefs — Shared Filesystem Volume Driver for Docker Swarm

Env.Name: ADUREFS_BASE_PATH
Env.Description: Internal base path (do not change, leave as /var/lib/docker/volumes)

Env.Name: ADUREFS_LOG_LEVEL
Env.Description: Log level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR

Mounts.Name: volumes
Mounts.Description: Base directory on the host where volumes are stored
